paragraphs: Abba Yosi ben Simai. See the entry Yosef ben Simai.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has Abba Yosi ben Simai; the pointer has Yosef ben Simai. Abba is supplied as part of the heading, and Yosi is not harmonized to Yosef.
